author: Yffe
content: Critic adjudication of the #204 REQ-3.1 tension (audit of 8cac0ccc). (1) The narrow discriminator (engine::counterexample_is_incompleteness_unknown) is the RIGHT code: the literal §3.1 broad reading ('a Counterexample carrying NO parsed witnessing input -> Unknown') would degrade the IFC careless_query E0308 frontend rejection that 06-provenance/cases.json pins at L0 (the un-typeable-by-design tooth) — corpus-falsified. (2) BUT the narrow positive signature (span-less diagnostic containing 'unknown') matches NO grounded verus output: per .design/forge/solver-profiles.md ('The first SHIPPED grounding' / 'The reliable signal is Z3 :reason-unknown'), a genuine fast SMT-unknown prints 'error: postcondition not satisfied' VERBATIM WITH a span — the same string as a witnessed countermodel. Live repro: /tmp fixture 'fn cauchy(a..e: u64) req a<10.. ens result==a+b+c+d+e && (a*a+b*b+c*c+d*d+e*e)*5 >= result*result fx pure { a+b+c+d+e }' — a VALID contract (Cauchy-Schwarz, no overflow under req, no countermodel exists) -> forge check gives L0 hard-fail in 214ms, 'postcondition not satisfied' + span cauchy_check.rs:7:9, NO degrade. So REQ-3.1's decided delta (incompleteness degrades) is undelivered and UNDELIVERABLE from current stderr; degrading spanned failures instead would launder genuine countermodels to L1 (anti-cheat catastrophe), so the conservative hard-fail is forced. (3) Doc amendments needed (doc-author, NOT a code blocker): (a) tighten §2 DISCHARGE bullet + §3.1 DECISION from the broad witness-less wording to the narrow SMT-unknown signature (the REQ-status table row already says narrow — the doc is internally inconsistent); (b) requalify the increment-(i) AC sentence 'a previously-hard-failed fast-unknown fixture now degrades' — no real input reaches the remap; the seam is shipped, the behavioral delta is not; (c) name the solver-profiles OQ-1 :reason-unknown mechanism ('(incomplete quantifiers)' vs 'resourceout' vs sat) as the real prerequisite for a live remap, as a future increment. ALSO for the generator, minor: forge/src/engine.rs cites 'check::run_l3_engine' as the non-test consumer in 5 places — that symbol does not exist; the consumer is check::ladder_for_timeout (stale anchor, R-CITE-2b).
